metadata.label: HTTP authentication challenges
metadata.baseline: Frozen original C++ tokenizer, round policy and strict modp decoder; original base ASCII normalization, shared C++ name/value iterator and scheme metadata remain unchanged external dependencies.
metadata.measurement: Complete public tokenizer, parameter iteration and first/later round calls, including ownership, FFI, decoding, output consumption and destruction. Constructor, destructor, base64_param, param_pairs and first/later parser APIs preserve their original out-of-line call boundaries in separate components. Inline field getters remain inline on both sides. Original base::ToLowerASCII DLL call is retained. Warm input and setup excluded; isolated operation, not whole-browser performance.
metadata.chart_scope: Public tokenizer and first/later round, C++/Rust FFI
metadata.chart_baseline: Baseline: frozen original C++ challenge parsing
